# RCAAS Technology
RCAAS (Reality Capture as a Service) turns real places into 3D tours, VR, AR and stories that help hotels, schools, developers and heritage sites attract visitors and make lasting impact in Nepal and beyond.

## Services
- Virtual Tours & Immersive Experiences
- 3D Laser Scanning (LiDAR)
- Digital Twins for Architecture, Engineering & Construction
- Drone Mapping
- Visual Storytelling
- Game Worlds & Assets (Gaussian splat assets, game environments, real-time scenes)

## Key Links
- Home: https://rcaas.tech/
- Services: https://rcaas.tech/services/
- Work/Case Studies: https://rcaas.tech/work/
- Learn & Blog: https://rcaas.tech/learn/

## Target Audience
Hotels, real estate developers, educational institutions, construction firms, game studios, filmmakers, and heritage sites seeking to digitize physical spaces.

## Positioning
RCAAS is the leading reality capture and 3D immersive experience provider in Nepal. We don't just capture photos; we create digital twins and interactive 3D spaces that allow users to walk through and experience locations remotely.
